name: zclass_cls_di_append_pick_candidates_for_face
description: zClass_cls_di::AppendPickCandidatesForFace expands optional morph vertices, transforms a segment into model space, tests face entries through textured or untextured polygon helpers, assigns the scene payload, and transforms accepted hits back to world space.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this face-dispatch helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL reuses incoming stack argument slots for matrix pointers, face indices, and face-entry byte offsets, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected assembly and native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x484fc0 validates the null and zero-face rejection, morph flag/weight/count gate, zMath::Vec3ArrayAddScaled call into g_zModel_SharedVec3ScratchA, current-matrix identity branch, inverse model-space conversion of segment endpoints, 0x1c-byte face-entry stride, vertex-index copy into g_zClass_DiFaceVertexScratch4, scene-payload damage-mask flag dispatch to the textured helper, untextured helper fallback, scenePayload assignment, optional world-space hit position and normal transform, EAX success return, and two-stack-argument cleanup.

The native cls_di smoke verifies untextured face hit and payload propagation, textured damage-mask UV dispatch, morph-vertex expansion through the shared scratch buffer, and current-matrix world/model conversion of hit position and surface normal.
